sn17.30:1.2: yo pi so bhikkhave, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo, tassa pāhaṃ lābhasakkārasiloko antarāyāya vadāmīti.
sn17.30:1.3: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn17.30:1.4: kissa pana bhante, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno lābhasakkārasiloko antarāyāyāti?
sn17.30:1.5: yā hissa sā ānanda, akuppā ceto vimutti, nāhaṃ tassā lābhasakkāra silokaṃ antarāyāya vadāmi.
sn17.30:1.6: ye ca khvassa ānanda appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārā adhigatā, tesāhamassa lābhasakkārasilokaṃ antarāyāya vadāmi.
sn17.30:1.7: evaṃ dāruṇo kho ānanda, lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso, antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
sn17.30:1.9: uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pajahissāma, na ca no uppanno lābhasakkārasiloko cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti.
